vision.name: Saiyan Scientific Blitz
vision.text:
(Saiyan Defiant Mastery only.)
[Attack] 2: Energy attack.
Your Styled energy attacks cost -2 stages (to a minimum of 0) this combat. [Warning]: At the end of this turn, look at the top 6 cards of your Life Deck and put them back in any order.
DAMAGE: 3 life cards.
(Banish after use.)
(Created by Cheyne Runnells, OP4 East Kai Champion)
vision.note: Organized Play card (OP5 folder; credit line names OP4 Champion); deck restriction names a specific Mastery; black warning triangle transcribed as [Warning]; stage cost printed as '2:'; no Endurance badge
